socfpga_uart_reg.h

UART register definition header for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

System and Clock Registers
Constants
UART base addressing

Base address of one UART instance. Instances are 4 KB (0x1000) apart.

GET_UART_BASE_ADDRESS

Base address of the given instance.

Clock Manager peripheral PLL (PERPLL)

Address and bit that turn the UART clock on or off.

CLK_PERPLL

Register the driver reads to see the clock gate.

CLK_EN_SHIFT

Start bit of the UART clock enable. The driver adds the instance number.

CLK_PERPLL_EN

Register the driver writes to turn the UART clock on or off.

Reset Manager peripheral module (PERMOD)

Address and bit shift for the UART hard reset in the Reset Manager.

RST_MGR

Base address of the Reset Manager.

RST_SHIFT

Bit shift of the UART reset bit (bit 16).

RST_PERMOD

Peripheral module reset register, at RST_MGR plus 0x28.

Core 16550 UART Registers

The foundational Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) register offsets for the UART controller. These align with the industry-standard 16550 UART specification.

Constants
UART_RBR

Receive Buffer Register (Read Only). The FIFO port where incoming serial bytes are retrieved by software.

UART_THR

Transmit Holding Register (Write Only). The FIFO port where outgoing software bytes are pushed to be serialized over the TX line.

UART_DLL

Divisor Latch Low. The lower 8 bits of the clock divider used to set the baud rate. (Only accessible when DLAB=1 in the LCR).

UART_IER

Interrupt Enable Register. Masks or unmasks specific hardware interrupt sources (e.g., RX Data Available, TX Empty).

UART_DLH

Divisor Latch High. The upper 8 bits of the baud rate clock divider.  (Only accessible when DLAB=1 in the LCR).

UART_IIR

Interrupt Identification Register (Read Only). Used by the ISR to determine the highest-priority pending interrupt.

UART_FCR

FIFO Control Register (Write Only). Enables the FIFOs, clears their contents, and configures the DMA/Interrupt trigger watermark levels.

UART_LCR

Line Control Register. Configures the physical framing format (word length, stop bits, parity) and toggles the Divisor Latch Access Bit (DLAB).

UART_MCR

Modem Control Register. Manages hardware flow control pins (RTS/DTR) and internal diagnostic loopback modes.

UART_LSR

Line Status Register. Provides real-time status of the data lines and FIFOs, including framing errors, parity errors, and FIFO empty/full states.

UART_MSR

Modem Status Register. Provides the current state of the modem control lines (CTS, DSR, RI, DCD).

UART_SCR

Scratchpad Register. A general-purpose 8-bit register that software can use for data storage; it has no effect on UART operation.

DesignWare Extensions and Shadow Registers

Synopsys DesignWare specific extensions to the standard 16550 map. These include shadow registers for deep FIFO access and advanced component parameter configurations.

Advanced FIFO and status control

Offsets of the extra FIFO, status, reset, and shadow control registers.

UART_FAR

FIFO access register.

UART_TFR

Transmit FIFO read register.

UART_RFW

Receive FIFO write register.

UART_USR

UART status register. The driver reads it before writing or reading a byte.

UART_TFL

Transmit FIFO level register.

UART_RFL

Receive FIFO level register.

UART_SRR

Software reset register.

UART_SRTS

Shadow request-to-send register.

UART_SBCR

Shadow break-control register.

UART_SDMAM

Shadow DMA mode register.

UART_SFE

Shadow FIFO enable register.

UART_SRT

Shadow receive-trigger register.

UART_STET

Shadow transmit-empty trigger register.

UART_HTX

Halt-transmit register.

UART_DMASA

DMA software-acknowledge register.

Component identification

Offsets of the parameter, version, and type registers.

UART_CPR

Component parameter register.

UART_UCV

UART component version register.

UART_CTR

Component type register.

Register Bit Masks and Positions

Defines the specific bitwise layout for extracting or modifying fields within the hardware registers.

Constants
Buffer and latch masks

Masks and bit positions for the data bytes and the baud divisor.

UART_RBR_RBR_MASK

Mask for the received byte (bits 7:0).

UART_RBR_RBR_POS

Bit position of the received byte (bit 0).

UART_DLL_DLL_MASK

Mask for the low byte of the baud divisor (bits 7:0).

UART_DLL_DLL_POS

Bit position of the low byte of the baud divisor (bit 0).

UART_THR_THR_MASK

Mask for the byte to transmit (bits 7:0).

UART_THR_THR_POS

Bit position of the byte to transmit (bit 0).

UART_DLH_DLH_MASK

Mask for the high byte of the baud divisor (bits 7:0).

UART_DLH_DLH_POS

Bit position of the high byte of the baud divisor (bit 0).

IER - interrupt enable register

Masks and bit positions in the interrupt enable register.

UART_IER_PTIME_MASK

Mask for bit 7 of the interrupt enable register. The driver sets it when the transmit interrupt is enabled.

UART_IER_PTIME_POS

Bit position 7 of the interrupt enable register.

UART_IER_EDSSI_MASK

Mask for bit 3 of the interrupt enable register.

UART_IER_EDSSI_POS

Bit position 3 of the interrupt enable register.

UART_IER_ELSI_MASK

Mask for the line-status interrupt enable (bit 2). The driver sets it for the hardware-error interrupt.

UART_IER_ELSI_POS

Bit position of the line-status interrupt enable (bit 2).

UART_IER_ETBEI_MASK

Mask for the transmit-empty interrupt enable (bit 1). The driver sets it to enable the transmit interrupt.

UART_IER_ETBEI_POS

Bit position of the transmit-empty interrupt enable (bit 1).

UART_IER_ERBFI_MASK

Mask for the receive-data interrupt enable (bit 0). The driver sets it to enable the receive interrupt.

UART_IER_ERBFI_POS

Bit position of the receive-data interrupt enable (bit 0).

IIR - interrupt identification register

Masks and bit positions in the interrupt identification register.

UART_IIR_FIFOSE_MASK

Mask for bits 7:6 of the interrupt identification register.

UART_IIR_FIFOSE_POS

Bit position 6 of the interrupt identification register.

UART_IIR_IID_MASK

Mask for the interrupt ID (bits 3:0). The driver reads these bits to see which event is pending.

UART_IIR_IID_POS

Bit position of the interrupt ID (bit 0).

FCR - FIFO control register

Masks and bit positions in the FIFO control register.

UART_FCR_RT_MASK

Mask for the receive trigger level (bits 7:6).

UART_FCR_RT_POS

Bit position of the receive trigger level (bit 6).

UART_FCR_TET_MASK

Mask for the transmit-empty trigger level (bits 5:4).

UART_FCR_TET_POS

Bit position of the transmit-empty trigger level (bit 4).

UART_FCR_DMAM_MASK

Mask for the DMA mode select (bit 3).

UART_FCR_DMAM_POS

Bit position of the DMA mode select (bit 3).

UART_FCR_XFIFOR_MASK

Mask for the transmit FIFO reset (bit 2). The driver sets it when it sets up the FIFOs.

UART_FCR_XFIFOR_POS

Bit position of the transmit FIFO reset (bit 2).

UART_FCR_RFIFOR_MASK

Mask for the receive FIFO reset (bit 1). The driver sets it when it sets up the FIFOs.

UART_FCR_RFIFOR_POS

Bit position of the receive FIFO reset (bit 1).

UART_FCR_FIFOE_MASK

Mask for the FIFO enable (bit 0). The driver sets it to turn the FIFOs on.

UART_FCR_FIFOE_POS

Bit position of the FIFO enable (bit 0).

LCR - line control register

Masks and bit positions in the line control register.

UART_LCR_DLAB_MASK

Mask for the divisor latch access bit (bit 7). The driver sets it to 1 before writing the baud divisor, then clears it.

UART_LCR_DLAB_POS

Bit position of the divisor latch access bit (bit 7).

UART_LCR_BREAK_MASK

Mask for the break control bit (bit 6).

UART_LCR_BREAK_POS

Bit position of the break control bit (bit 6).

UART_LCR_SP_MASK

Mask for bit 5 of the line control register.

UART_LCR_SP_POS

Bit position 5 of the line control register.

UART_LCR_EPS_MASK

Mask for the even-parity select (bit 4). The driver sets it, with parity enable, for even parity.

UART_LCR_EPS_POS

Bit position of the even-parity select (bit 4).

UART_LCR_PEN_MASK

Mask for the parity enable (bit 3). The driver sets it for odd or even parity.

UART_LCR_PEN_POS

Bit position of the parity enable (bit 3).

UART_LCR_STOP_MASK

Mask for the stop-bit select (bit 2). The driver sets it for two stop bits.

UART_LCR_STOP_POS

Bit position of the stop-bit select (bit 2).

UART_LCR_DLS_MASK

Mask for the data length (bits 1:0). The driver stores the word length minus 5 here.

UART_LCR_DLS_POS

Bit position of the data length (bit 0).
